card.name: Words just before a drug or patient group
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction and dosing text that come right before a named drug, patient group or 'with' phrase, such as 'used', 'administration', 'given', 'dosage' and 'individuals'.

modes.label: Co-use verbs
modes.description: Words meaning use together, placed right before 'with' and a drug name.

modes.label: Dosage and patient nouns
modes.description: Nouns like dosage or individuals that come before a quantity or a condition.
